name: Can I install radiant heating under basement flooring?

mainEntity.name: Can I install radiant heating under basement flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, radiant heating can be installed under many types of basement flooring, providing a comfortable and energy-efficient way to warm the space. It is commonly installed beneath tile, engineered wood, and some LVP products. However, not all flooring materials are compatible with radiant heating; for example, some LVP manufacturers may have specific limitations or require a particular installation method. Always check the flooring manufacturer's guidelines and consult with your contractor to ensure compatibility and proper installation for your chosen system.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, radiant heating can be installed under basement flooring like tile or engineered wood, but compatibility depends on the specific flooring material. Check manufacturer guidelines.
